I have farmed this small plot for many years using the ways my mother taught me. I do not have money for chemical fertilizer or those new seeds from the city, but I will put goat manure and compost on the soil as I always do. The rains will come as God provides, so I do not need irrigation, and my family will pull the weeds by hand rather than using costly sprays. Because I am getting old, I will hire some young men for a few days when it is time to do the heavy digging.
